headline: Mythic role assigns RNM creation and mixed-signal verification for an analog-compute core
fact: Mythic posted a Senior Digital & Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer role responsible for making its analog flash-compute core accurately and thoroughly verifiable in digital and mixed-signal flows. The position spans RNM creation and verification, UVM, top-level algorithm verification, mixed-signal interfaces and specifications, and controller and FSM verification for data converters, PLLs, and power converters. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate, not proof of verification completion or product deployment.

sources.title: Mythic Careers API: Senior Digital & Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
sources.summary: The official Lever API record exposes an October 30, 2025 creation timestamp and describes RNM creation, analog-compute-core verification, UVM, top-level algorithms, and mixed-signal controller verification.
